{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert the 'revenue' column from string to float, handling any non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any NaN values after conversion
print("Number of NaN values in revenue after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Filter only completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
